target: Within the single Rivière-aux-Feuilles herd, test whether spring migration-route longitude variance adds future-held-out predictive information for fall calf recruitment beyond the preceding year's recruitment and observation effort.

provenance_boundary.literature_exposure: Original paper's null-to-weak AICc comparison and outcome direction were already published and read; this is not an outcome-blind preregistration.
provenance_boundary.schema_exposure: Header Annee,Recrutement,Moyenne_long,Variance_long,Moyenne_58,Nb_femelle and raw row count 26 were recovered and hashed before the analysis contract.
provenance_boundary.project_outcome_exposure: No row-level Recrutement values, effect estimates, model predictions, fitted coefficients or holdout scores were opened by this project before this contract.
provenance_boundary.consequence: This is a constrained retrospective forecasting audit, not an independent discovery data set or prospective natural validation of Love-Otto.

sampling_unit: calendar year of a single herd
temporal_direction: spring migration-route distribution in year y precedes autumn recruitment in the same year y; baseline recruitment measured in autumn y-1

models.estimator: ordinary least squares, unregularized, with intercept and no after-outcome hyperparameter tuning
models.transformations: identity of source-provided variables; each predictor standardized from training years within each forecast fold only
models.temporal_holdout: expanding-window rolling-origin one-year-ahead forecasts; no year >= target year enters any training set
scores: paired yearwise squared error difference M0-M1
models.primary_positive_rule: M1 must have lower RMSE and MAE on exactly the same held-out years
models.primary_stop_rule: fewer than 11 eligible lagged years or any required training-fold matrix singularity -> STOP, no model rescue

secondary.other_geography: after primary is recorded, one sensitivity replacing Variance_long with Moyenne_long; no winner-selection primary update
secondary.author_aic: retain published source-model AICc comparison as existing descriptive literature, not our temporal validation result

prohibitions: Do not silently treat missing years as adjacent years for lagged recruitment.
Do not use current autumn recruitment as a predictor of itself.
Do not tune year, direction, horizon, predictor sign, thresholds or spatial metric after opening response rows.
Do not substitute source metric Moyenne_58 if source primary Variance_long is null or invalid.
Do not treat the 811 routes or 304 individuals as independent annual future-outcome replicates.
Do not label longitude variance an individual-pairwise Love-Otto CV or direct test of its diagnostic metrics.
Do not pool this herd with Ya Ha Tinda as independent repetitions of one matched metric.
claim_ceiling: A year-level heldout reanalysis of an already published wild migration-route-versus-recruitment study. Does not validate Love-Otto IID spatial warning, prove causality, or provide cross-herd generality.

execution_result.confirmatory_scope: constrained retrospective single-herd year-forward audit after published conclusion was known
execution_result.warning: This is not a test of Love-Otto inter-individual-distance CV.
